projects.title: Volunteer Scheduling App
projects.description: We are a Habitat-for-Humanity-style nonprofit. Volunteers currently sign up by phone for weekly build days, which eats hours of coordinator time. We want a simple web app where volunteers can see open build days, sign up with one click, and get a confirmation email. Admins need a view of who's coming.

projects.title: Donor Impact Dashboard
projects.description: A food-pantry nonprofit wants a page where donors can see the real-world impact of their donations: meals served per month, families helped, categories of goods delivered. We have the data in a Google Sheet.

projects.title: Accessibility Audit + Fixes
projects.description: Our existing public site has accessibility issues reported by a user. We need someone to audit the site, document issues, and ship fixes for the top items — color contrast, keyboard nav, screen-reader labels.
